workflow_steps.title: Reproject borough boundaries to DEM CRS
workflow_steps.purpose: Make the borough polygons spatially compatible with the elevation raster.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the input borough polygon layer from its known source CRS EPSG:26918 to the explicitly specified target CRS EPSG:3857.

workflow_steps.title: Calculate mean elevation by borough
workflow_steps.purpose: Calculate the average DEM elevation within the State College and Bellefonte borough boundaries.
workflow_steps.instructions: Compute zonal statistics for the reprojected borough polygons over the DEM and produce a CSV summary containing the mean elevation for each borough, retaining the borough identity attributes needed to distinguish State College and Bellefonte.

agent_profile_snapshot.name: Projection Agent
agent_profile_snapshot.description: Reprojects vector artifacts between explicitly identified coordinate reference systems and assigns a CRS when explicitly supplied. The service never guesses an unknown CRS.

skills.name: Coordinate Transformation
skills.description: Transforms vector geometry coordinates to a target CRS or defines an explicit CRS on datasets with missing metadata.

constraints.spatial: Reprojection requires a known source CRS and an explicit target CRS. assign_crs requires an explicit CRS to assign.
other: The service does not infer or guess unknown coordinate reference systems.

input_datasets.description: Vector dataset in GeoPackage or GeoJSON format.

agent_profile_snapshot.name: Raster Analysis Agent
agent_profile_snapshot.description: Performs deterministic raster reprojection, resampling, clipping, raster calculation, and zonal statistics. Consumes GeoTIFF rasters and GeoPackage polygon zones.

skills.name: Raster Geoprocessing
skills.description: Executes raster calculations, reprojections, grid resampling, spatial masking, and zonal aggregations.

constraints.spatial: Raster calculation requires compatible grid definitions and CRS. Zonal statistics require matching CRS between raster and GeoPackage zones.
other: Accepts GeoTIFF (.tif) rasters and GeoPackage (.gpkg) polygon zones.
Does not accept GeoJSON zones for zonal statistics.

input_datasets.description: GeoTIFF raster file(s) and optional GeoPackage polygon zone layer.

operation.description: Explicit operation (zonal_statistics, raster_calculator, resample, clip, reproject_raster).

resolution.description: Target pixel resolution in meters for resampling.

target_crs.description: Target coordinate reference system for raster reprojection.
